# LEXYGO Material Handling Equipment

> Zhejiang Changxing Shengli Intelligent Machinery Co., Ltd. supplies model-specific pallet trucks, pallet stackers, electric forklifts, manual pallet trucks, and warehouse equipment.

## Product families
- [Electric Pallet Trucks](https://www.lexygolift.com/products/electric-pallet-trucks/): Move palletized loads efficiently across warehouses, docks, and mixed surfaces.
- [Electric Pallet Stackers](https://www.lexygolift.com/products/electric-pallet-stackers/): Lift, place, and retrieve pallets in low- to medium-height storage areas.
- [Electric Forklifts](https://www.lexygolift.com/products/electric-forklifts/): Electric counterbalanced forklifts for indoor logistics and industrial handling.
- [Manual Pallet Trucks](https://www.lexygolift.com/products/manual-pallet-trucks/): Simple, dependable pallet movement and manual high-lift handling.
- [Warehouse Equipment](https://www.lexygolift.com/products/warehouse-equipment/): Compact lifting tables, platform trucks, and support equipment for material flow.
